requirement: Transient widget startup reads recover without replaying messages, authentication or site operations

oracle.invariant: Temporary DNS, connection and database readiness failures return sanitized HTTP503 retryable true; unknown or unreadable context returns retryable false. Only state and catalogue GET reads may retry twice, with a ten-second timeout per attempt; POST adoption, message, authentication and creation requests are not automatically retried. Exhaustion provides an explicit single-flight retry action without clearing saved state, drafts or visitor cookies. Unreadable saved context is refused without cookie replacement or store writes; diagnostics contain fixed categories only.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/widget/route.js:542 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
